1428 Tomasita St. NE Albuquerque, New Mexico 87112
12 Oct 72
Mr. James W. Monroe United States Department of Interior Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Washington, D.C. 20240
Dear Mr. Monroe:
I have recently received the copy of the department's Draft Environmental Statement along with a copy of the letter you sent to my congressman, the Honorable Manuel Lujan, Jr. Thank you for such a comprehensive reply to my inquiries concerning off-raod vehicle use of public lands.
It is apparrent from the documents sent me that the President and the Department of Interior are concerned with providing public lands that are available for all sorts of recreation, both for use by off-road vehicles and others. I feel that the Draft Environmental Statement represents a sound approach to the problem of off-road vehicle use of public lands, however the dev to the problem will be the efficacy with which the usage guidelines for these areas are enforced. I wholeheartedly support the responsible use of public lands, and do not wish to have my usage of these areas curtailed by irresponsible use by others.
I hope that the intent of the Executive Order, to provide suitable areas for off-road vehicles as well as protecting the environment, is not compromised by excessive pressure from those individuals who would ban all off-road vehicle traffic.
I am looking forward to seeing the results of this study in ensuing months.
Respectfully yours,
ROGER A. DEAN
